newsitem.title: UK: Barclays raised to "outperform" at Lehman.
newsitem.headline: Barclays raised to "outperform" at Lehman.

text.p: Barclays Plc was raised to "outperform" at Lehman Brothers following its recent decline, analysts at the brokerage said on Wednesday.

In a research note analyst Robert Law said the share price correction since the bank's recent results was overdone and that fears over pressure on profit margins and the performance of its BZW unit were "excessive."
The note said the valuation on Barclays shares looked attractive, including a price-to-book multiple of 2.3 times, a 23 percent return on equity and prospective price-earnings multiple of 10.4 times.
